name: nw-worktrees
description: Keeps your Dart SDK VS Code workspace and open editor tabs following `nw` worktree switches without reloading the window.

commands.title: Dart Worktrees: Scope Workspace to Package / Subfolder…
Dart Worktrees: Sync Window with Latest nw Checkout

nwWorktrees.followNw.description: Automatically switch workspace folders and remap open tabs when `nw` changes the active Dart SDK worktree.

nwWorktrees.followDsSdk.description: Keep workspace `dart.sdkPath` synced to the checkout selected by `ds` (~/.dart-current) whenever a built SDK exists there.
